tools.name: find_events
tools.description: Searches SGL’s public events (tournaments, leagues, hobby nights) by game, place, date or day of the week, e.g. a Warhammer 40,000 game near Provo on Thursday. Nearest first when a place is given. Players sign up on SGL itself, through each event’s url.

tools.name: get_public_event
tools.description: A public event’s details: when and where, the format (rounds, cut, brackets), the price and refund rule, spots left, the waitlist, check-in and what to bring.

tools.name: find_stores
tools.description: Game stores and clubs on SGL near a place, optionally ones that run a game: address, opening hours, phone, the games they list, their next public events and their calendar feed.

tools.name: event_calendar_links
tools.description: Links that add a public event to Google Calendar or Outlook, and an .ics file for Apple Calendar and the rest.

tools.name: event_standings
tools.description: A public event’s standings for each format that has started (rank, name, record and points), or its final places when it’s over.

tools.name: player_profile
tools.description: What a player shows publicly on SGL: their games, teams, in-game ranks, badges, ratings and event history (only the parts they made public). Without a screen name, the signed-in person’s own profile.

tools.name: find_games
tools.description: Search SGL’s games by name to get a gameId for an event (or the exact name for find_events).
